dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin with a steep positive slope of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.7:1 ratio of maximum visible basal width to maximum vertical height.
